description: This file defines template classes and functions for managing plugin interfaces within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes classes for referencing, building, and creating plugin interface instances, as well as utility functions. The file also manages external dependencies and logging mechanisms.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceRef
classes.description: A template class managing a reference to a plugin interface, handling resource management and move semantics.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder
classes.description: A template class for constructing plugin interface instances with configurable parameters such as version, timeout, retry count, and interval.

methods.name: createInterface
methods.description: Creates and returns a plugin interface instance using the provided builder.

methods.name: make_unique
methods.description: A utility template function to create a std::unique_ptr for a given type with forwarded arguments.
